My dear [Mr Moor](/person/1046)
I think it will be much better to throw the prizes open to the whole schools [sic]; it is so discouraging and troublesome to be put out of the competition, and everyone has not a garden who has children at school
My [mother](/person/1606) says she meant her prizes instead of the home prize - of course they would chiefly concern the first - not the second - if all the extraparochial people are necessarily in the 3d class, she would extend it to them.
I suppose it will not wait till we see you

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
